title: REQ · Submit success, API error and quota exhausted outcomes are individually identifiable
summary: Each submit outcome has its own element that tests can target
description: Context: ContributionSheet shows success via data-testid contribution-success, but the error alert and the quota-used message have no test ids. Desired behavior: the error alert and zero-quota message carry test ids. Expected result: tests assert success, 500 error, 409 error and quota exhausted separately. Why: SG-8.5 submit coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 201 response, when Send is clicked, then contribution-success shows 'Suggestion sent'
Given a 500 response, when Send is clicked, then contribution-error shows 'Could not send'
Given a 409 response, when Send is clicked, then contribution-error shows 'Limit reached or duplicate idea'
Given 5 sent contributions in history, when the sheet opens, then contribution-quota is shown and Send is disabled

in_scope: Test ids for error and quota alerts

definition_of_done: Test ids present and submit tests pass
